name: Local Agents
description: Local Hermes and Antigravity delegation tools with Hermes-first fallback routing.

hermes_ask.description: Delegate a complex local coding, review, or analysis task to the installed Hermes Agent in one-shot mode.

agy_ask.description: Delegate a local task to the installed Antigravity/AGY CLI in non-interactive print mode.

smart_delegate.description: Try Hermes first for a complex local task and fall back to AGY only if the Hermes process fails.
